summary: Resideo Technologies filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting the completion of its separation of the ADI Global Distribution business via a spin-off. On July 31, 2026, Resideo entered into separation, employee matters, tax matters, transition services, and IP agreements with ADI. The distribution of ADI common stock to Resideo stockholders occurred on August 3, 2026, with ADI trading under ADIG on NYSE. ADI also issued 150,000 shares of Series A preferred stock to Resideo as partial consideration. The spin-off creates two independent public companies; watch for post-distribution trading dynamics and any tax rulings or indemnification issues.
